method.advance: Retain at least 85% of the noisy synthetic additions overall and 75% per background. Retain all clean synthetic additions. Require at least six available noisy synthetic additions, at least two fewer genuine noisy flags and at least one removal in each tape. These are evaluation conditions, not public thresholds.
method.development: No more than four of the 24 synthetic noisy additions may be lost. For each arm select the highest point retaining 20 additions, given admitted scores. When fewer than 20 are admitted the arm is unqualified. A qualified point must remove at least two genuine development flags. All feasible arms are measured descriptively on the holdout without refitting, including arms that did not qualify for adoption on development. Clean behavior is measured separately and used in confirmation admission.
method.development_replay: Require the same primary assessment, speech admission, and enhanced whole-window flag as in the historical run. The whole-window logit must be within 0.001 of the prior measurement. Retain each run's enhanced PCM digest to expose any numeric variation.
method.disjoint_edges: Minimum of the two non-overlapping 1.5-s portions (left/right). Both portions must pass speech admission. No sample overlap, but the same source and classifier are shared.
method.input: Exact prior source-bound 16 kHz WAVs for development. Holdout is 18 additional English RADAR files per class with one whole-file label, 3–14 seconds, fixed hash order, and no known file or PCM overlap. Save center three seconds, matched gain-only and separate -5 dB RMS mixtures from DEMAND channel 1. Keep four isolated excerpts from each tape.
method.only_if: Probe only supplemental positive responses at the unchanged point. No new flag is allowed and no primary result may change. Audition and score the processed waveform using the existing local assets.
method.persistence: Median of at least two estimated scores among the three 1.5-s enhanced subwindows. When exactly two are admitted use the smaller reading. The 1.5-s scores are ordinal and receive a separate empirical point.
method.processed_band: One response on enhanced PCM after a 250–3400 Hz order-4 zero-phase band-pass. Speech admission uses the full unfiltered enhanced view, as for the incumbent.
